The '''1925 Nebraska Wesleyan Coyotes football team''' was an [[American football]] team that represented [[Nebraska Wesleyan University]] as a member of the [[North Central Conference]] (NCC) during the [[1925 college football season]]. In its first season under head coach [[Clarence L. Dow]], the team compiled a 6–0–2 record (3–0–1 against NCC opponents), shut out seven of eight opponents, did not allow its goal line to be crossed, and outscored all opponents by a total of 76 to 3.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nebraska Wesleyan University All-Time Football Results|publisher=Nebraska Wesleyan University|accessdate=April 24, 2019|url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/sidearm.sites/nebrwesleyan.sidearmsports.com/documents/2019/4/5/FB_All_Time_Results.pdf}}</ref> The team played its home games at Johnson Field in [[Lincoln, Nebraska]].

Fullback Oscar Wiberg was the team captain.<ref name=o17/> Wiberg and tackle Huyck were selected as first-team players on the 1925 All-North Central Conference football team.<ref>{{cite news|title=Mythical Honors To Coyote Stars|newspaper=Sunday State Journal|date=December 13, 1925|page=7|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/31026223/mythical_honors_to_coyote_stars/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>
